faqAccordion.question: How does MapleCodix approach website performance and speed?
faqAccordion.answer: We prioritize performance from line one. Rather than relying on heavy templates or bloated plugins, we write clean TypeScript, modern Tailwind CSS, and optimized bundle sizes. We test every build with Google PageSpeed Insights targeting 90+ mobile and desktop scores.

faqAccordion.question: Can I update content on my website without technical knowledge?
faqAccordion.answer: Yes. We configure user-friendly Content Management Systems (like headless CMS, Sanity, Strapi, or Shopify) allowing your team to update text, upload images, add blog posts, and modify products through an intuitive visual dashboard.

faqAccordion.question: What is the typical timeline for an end-to-end custom build?
faqAccordion.answer: A standard bespoke website typically takes 2 to 4 weeks from discovery to deployment. More complex platforms, custom SaaS web apps, and native mobile applications range from 4 to 10 weeks depending on custom integrations and scope.

faqAccordion.question: Do you handle custom third-party integrations and payment gateways?
faqAccordion.answer: Absolutely. We routinely integrate Stripe, PayPal, Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, custom REST/GraphQL APIs, webhook pipelines, and automated CRM notifications.

faqAccordion.question: What happens after launch? Do you offer ongoing maintenance and growth?
faqAccordion.answer: We never leave our clients stranded after launch. We provide post-launch support warranties, ongoing security and dependency maintenance, and performance marketing retainers to continuously drive traffic and optimize conversions.
